description:
Ask one prompt of AI answer engines and report, per engine, whether the brand's URL was cited, whether and where the brand was named, which competitors were named, the cited sources and the sentiment. The run is saved as an audit.

Billing: 5–12¢ per engine check plus the fix-it playbook — Perplexity 5¢, ChatGPT 7¢, Google AI Overviews 9¢, Gemini 12¢ (33¢ per prompt on the four default engines), Google AI Mode 10¢ when requested. Only answered checks bill; a repeat within an hour is served from cache at full price. After the checks AuditAE writes a fix-it playbook for each answered check that didn't cite the brand, billed on LLM usage (about 12¢ each), plus about 45¢ for the audit rollup — one prompt on the four default engines is about 126¢ if no engine cites the brand. charged_cents in the response is what the run billed.

When to call: the user asks whether an engine cites or names the brand for a question, or wants a prompt re-checked after a fix. To read an existing audit, use get_audit.

Inputs:
  brand — as written in prose (e.g. "Linear").
  domain — the brand's primary domain (e.g. "linear.app"); matched against sources, not fetched.
  prompt — the question to ask (e.g. "best pm tool for startups").
  engines — optional subset of [chatgpt, perplexity, gemini, ai-overviews, ai-mode]; default the first four.

Returns { audit_id, report_url, results: [{engine, prompt, status, brand_mentioned, brand_url_cited, position, competitors, sources, sentiment, was_cache_hit, error_message, answer_excerpt}], citation_rate, completed, total, partial, out_of_credits, charged_cents, charged_breakdown_cents: {checks, playbook} }. report_url is a shareable public report — give it to the user. A playbook that doesn't finish in the call finishes in the background. Past ~45 s it returns { audit_id, status: "running", next_step } and finishes in the background; read it with get_audit (free).

Example: { brand: "Linear", domain: "linear.app", prompt: "best project management tool for startups", engines: ["perplexity"] }

brand.description: Brand name as written in prose (e.g. "Linear").

engines.description: Subset of engines to query. Defaults to the four core engines; add "ai-mode" for Google AI Mode (10¢/check).

prompt.description: Natural-language question to send to each engine.

name: check_brand_citation
title: Check brand citation across AI engines
